items.title_cn: 超声内镜引导下胰腺疾病及术后解剖改变患者胰管引流的处理：叙述性综述
items.title_en: Endoscopic ultrasound-guided management of pancreatic duct drainage in patients with pancreatic disease and surgically altered anatomy: a narrative review.
items.abstract_cn:
背景
胰空肠吻合口狭窄和胰管结石可能增加管内压力，导致解剖结构改变（尤其是胰十二指肠切除术后）的患者出现腹痛或复发性胰腺炎。球囊小肠镜辅助内镜逆行胰管造影是一种微创选择；然而，到达并识别吻合口以及实现选择性插管在技术上可能较为困难，导致相当高的失败率。

综述
内镜超声引导下胰管引流（EUS-PDD）是此类病例的有效替代方案，近期研究报告了较高的技术成功率和持久的症状控制。然而，该操作的每一步，包括胰管穿刺、导丝操作、通道扩张和支架置入，均存在特定的技术挑战，且胰液漏、出血、胰腺炎和支架移位等不良事件仍具有临床意义。本叙述性综述聚焦于解剖结构改变患者的EUS-PDD，特别是因胰空肠吻合口狭窄和胰管结石导致复发性胰腺炎的患者。总结了患者选择、治疗流程、操作技术和实用技巧、问题处理以及短期和长期临床结局。我们还讨论了通过成熟的EUS创建通道治疗胰管结石的方法。

关键信息
EUS-PDD不应仅被视为一种挽救性引流操作，而应被视为一个分期治疗的平台，旨在实现吻合口再通、结石清除、预防复发性胰腺炎，并在可行时最终实现无支架管理。总体而言，仔细的病例选择、专用器械和多学科支持仍是安全实施的关键。
items.abstract_en:
BACKGROUND
Pancreaticojejunostomy anastomotic strictures and pancreatic duct stones may increase intraductal pressure and cause abdominal pain or recurrent pancreatitis in patients with surgically altered anatomy, particularly after pancreaticoduodenectomy. Balloon enteroscopy-assisted endoscopic retrograde pancreatography is a minimally invasive option; however, reaching and identifying the anastomosis and achieving selective cannulation can be technically difficult, resulting in a substantial failure rate.


SUMMARY
Endoscopic ultrasound-guided pancreatic duct drainage (EUS-PDD) is an effective alternative in such cases, with recent studies reporting a high technical success rate and durable symptom control. Nevertheless, each step in this procedure, including pancreatic duct puncture, guidewire manipulation, tract dilation, and stent deployment, has specific technical challenges, and adverse events such as pancreatic juice leakage, bleeding, pancreatitis, and stent migration, remain clinically relevant. This narrative review focuses on EUS-PDD in patients with surgically altered anatomy, particularly those with recurrent pancreatitis caused by pancreaticojejunostomy stricture and pancreatic duct stones. Patient selection, treatment algorithms, procedural techniques and practical tips, troubleshooting, and short-term and long-term clinical outcomes are summarized. We also discuss treatment of pancreatic duct stones through a mature EUS-created tract.


KEY MESSAGES
EUS-PDD should be regarded not merely as a salvage drainage procedure but as a platform for staged therapy aimed at anastomotic recanalization, stone clearance, prevention of recurrent pancreatitis, and, when feasible, eventual stent-free management. Overall, careful case selection, dedicated devices, and multidisciplinary backup remain essential for safe implementation.
items.summary_cn: 该综述指出，对于解剖结构改变（尤其胰十二指肠切除术后）患者，EUS引导下胰管引流（EUS-PDD）是球囊小肠镜辅助ERP失败后的有效替代方案，技术成功率高且症状控制持久；EUS-PDD不应仅视为挽救性引流，而应作为分阶段治疗平台，用于吻合口再通、结石清除、预防复发性胰腺炎及最终无支架管理，但需注意胰管穿刺、导丝操作、通道扩张和支架置入各步骤的技术挑战及胰液漏、出血、胰腺炎、支架移位等不良事件。

items.title_cn: 血浆置换在高甘油三酯血症诱发的急性胰腺炎中的作用
items.title_en: O papel da plasmaférese na pancreatite aguda induzida por hipertrigliceridemia
items.abstract_cn: 目的：通过文献综述分析血浆置换在高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎治疗中的作用，并与保守治疗在甘油三酯降低、死亡率、住院时间和并发症方面进行比较。文献综述：高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎的临床重要性日益增加，可能与更高的严重程度和全身并发症相关。尽管快速降低甘油三酯被认为很重要，但关于血浆置换的证据仍然有限，主要依赖于观察性研究和存在方法学局限性的综述。近期系统综述未证明血浆置换相对于常规治疗（包括胰岛素治疗和强化支持）具有一致的优越性——尤其在死亡率和并发症方面。因此，其应用仍限于选定的较严重病例。最终考虑：血浆置换的使用仍存在争议，尚无既定共识。尽管血浆置换能快速降低甘油三酯水平，但缺乏关于其临床获益优越性的有力证据，限制了其常规使用。其适应证应基于疾病严重程度、对常规治疗的反应以及临床团队的评估进行个体化决策，有待更高质量的研究以建立更一致的推荐意见。
items.abstract_en: Objective: To analyze, through a literature review, the role of plasmapheresis in the treatment of hypertriglyceridemia-induced acute pancreatitis, comparing it to conservative treatment regarding triglyceride reduction, mortality, length of hospital stay, and complications. Literature review: Hypertriglyceridemia-induced acute pancreatitis is of growing clinical importance and may be associated with greater severity and systemic complications. Although rapid triglyceride reduction is considered important, evidence regarding plasmapheresis remains limited, relying predominantly on observational studies and reviews with methodological limitations. Recent systematic reviews do not demonstrate consistent superiority of plasmapheresis over conventional treatment—including insulin therapy and intensive support—particularly regarding mortality and complications. Thus, its use remains restricted to selected, more severe cases. Final considerations: The use of plasmapheresis remains controversial, with no established consensus. Despite rapidly reducing triglyceride levels, the lack of robust evidence regarding superior clinical benefit limits its routine use. Its indication should be individualized based on disease severity, response to conventional treatment, and the clinical team's assessment, pending higher-quality studies that establish more consistent recommendations.
items.summary_cn: 该综述指出，尽管血浆置换能快速降低甘油三酯水平，但近期系统评价未显示其较传统治疗（胰岛素治疗及强化支持）在死亡率、并发症等方面具有一致优势，证据主要来自观察性研究且存在方法学局限，因此其应用仍限于经选择的更严重病例，需个体化决策。

items.title_cn: 成人胰胆管合流异常与ERCP后胰腺炎的相关性：单中心回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Association of pancreaticobiliary maljunction with post-ERCP pancreatitis in adults: a single-center retrospective cohort study.
items.abstract_cn:
背景
胰胆管合流异常（PBM）是一种先天性异常，其胆总管与主胰管在解剖上于十二指肠壁外汇合。其与成人内镜逆行胰胆管造影术后胰腺炎（PEP）的关联尚不明确。我们评估了因良性胆道疾病行ERCP后该关联。

方法
本单中心回顾性队列研究纳入2021年8月至2023年12月期间首次符合条件接受ERCP的成人。PBM由两名内镜医师独立审阅的磁共振胰胆管成像或ERCP图像确定。主要结局为PEP。缺失数据采用链式方程多重插补。在调整人口学特征、病史及已确立的操作相关PEP危险因素后，采用Firth偏倚校正逻辑回归估计PBM与PEP的关联。

结果
队列包括PBM组101例患者和无PBM组587例患者；32例发生PEP。PBM组14例患者发生PEP（13.9%），无PBM组18例（3.1%），对应的绝对风险差为10.8个百分点（95%置信区间[CI]，5.1-18.9）。在完全调整模型中，PBM与更高的PEP odds相关（调整比值比[OR]，3.89；95% CI 1.76-8.58；P < 0.001）。敏感性分析在完整病例中得出的调整OR为3.36（95% CI 1.50-7.54），多重插补后采用传统逻辑回归为4.03（95% CI 1.75-9.29），进一步调整直肠非甾体抗炎药和预防性胰管支架置入后为3.99（95% CI 1.79-8.89）。

结论
在接受ERCP的成人中，PBM与显著更高的PEP odds相关。术前识别PBM可能加强PEP风险分层，并支持严格应用已确立的预防措施。
items.abstract_en:
BACKGROUND
Pancreaticobiliary maljunction (PBM) is a congenital anomaly in which the common bile duct and main pancreatic duct join anatomically outside the duodenal wall. Its association with post-endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) pancreatitis (PEP) in adults remains unclear. We evaluated this association after ERCP for benign biliary disease.


METHODS
This single-center retrospective cohort study included adults undergoing their first eligible ERCP from August 2021 to December 2023. PBM was ascertained from magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography or ERCP images independently reviewed by two endoscopists. The primary outcome was PEP. Missing data were multiply imputed using chained equations. Firth bias-reduced logistic regression estimated the PBM-PEP association after adjustment for demographic characteristics, medical history, and established procedure-related PEP risk factors.


RESULTS
The cohort comprised 101 patients in the PBM group and 587 in the No-PBM group; 32 developed PEP. PEP occurred in 14 patients in the PBM group (13.9%) and 18 in the No-PBM group (3.1%), corresponding to an absolute risk difference of 10.8 percentage points (95% confidence interval [CI], 5.1-18.9). In the fully adjusted model, PBM was associated with higher odds of PEP (adjusted odds ratio [OR], 3.89; 95% CI 1.76-8.58; P < 0.001). Sensitivity analyses yielded adjusted ORs of 3.36 (95% CI 1.50-7.54) in complete cases, 4.03 (95% CI 1.75-9.29) using conventional logistic regression after multiple imputation, and 3.99 (95% CI 1.79-8.89) after further adjustment for rectal nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and prophylactic pancreatic stenting.


CONCLUSIONS
PBM was associated with substantially higher odds of PEP in adults undergoing ERCP. Preprocedural recognition of PBM may strengthen PEP risk stratification and support meticulous application of established preventive measures.
items.summary_cn: 在因良性胆道疾病接受首次ERCP的成人中，胰胆管合流异常（PBM）患者的ERCP术后胰腺炎（PEP）发生率为13.9%，显著高于无PBM者的3.1%（绝对风险差10.8个百分点）；充分校正后PBM与PEP风险升高相关（调整OR 3.89，95%CI 1.76-8.58），敏感性分析结果一致。

items.title_cn: 重新思考原发性硬化性胆管炎合并炎症性肠病的内镜监测：面向胃肠病学家和内镜医师的实用综述
items.title_en: Rethinking Endoscopic Surveillance in Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis With Inflammatory Bowel Disease: A Practical Review for Gastroenterologists and Endoscopists
items.abstract_cn: 原发性硬化性胆管炎（PSC）是炎症性肠病（IBD）的肝胆并发症，也是最直接重塑内镜实践方式的并发症。它将常规的结肠炎随访转变为双器官肿瘤监测问题，并使消化内科医师而非肝病科医师成为结肠和胆管决策的关键节点。本综述从执业内镜医师的视角，审视支持PSC-IBD中胆道和结直肠监测的证据，并提出一条适用于高容量西方移植中心以外机构的、整合的、资源可及的诊疗路径。本研究采用结构化叙述性综述方法。检索PubMed和Embase数据库，时间范围为建库至2026年7月，使用受控词表及自由文本词检索PSC、IBD、胆管癌、胆管镜、胆道狭窄、异型增生和监测等主题。优先纳入临床实践指南、随机试验、荟萃分析及大型前瞻性队列研究。最终归纳出四个影响实践的主题。第一，常规胆道影像学检查用于胆管癌监测的获益仍不确定，其当前价值更多在于风险分层和移植分诊，而非治愈性早期发现。第二，内镜逆行胰胆管造影（ERCP）中的组织获取仍是该路径中最薄弱的环节：胆管镜下活检阳性具有诊断信息价值，但阴性结果不能排除恶性肿瘤。第三，对于有症状的胆道狭窄，球囊扩张而非短期支架置入应作为初始内镜治疗。第四，结直肠监测是PSC-IBD中获益-风险比最明确的干预措施，然而它恰恰是常规实践中最常执行不完整的环节。在PSC-IBD中，内镜医师应将最大精力投入结肠监测，有选择地以治疗而非诊断为目的应用ERCP，并认识到胆道监测目前只是一种等待更优生物标志物出现的过渡策略。本文提出了一条适用于无现场肝移植能力中心的务实诊疗路径。
items.abstract_en: Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) is the hepatobiliary complication of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) that most directly reshapes endoscopic practice. It converts a routine colitis follow-up into a dual-organ cancer surveillance problem, and it places the gastroenterologist, rather than the hepatologist, at the decision point for both the colon and the bile duct. This review examines, from the perspective of the practising endoscopist, the evidence underpinning biliary and colorectal surveillance in PSC-IBD and proposes an integrated, resource-aware care pathway applicable outside high-volume Western transplant centres. A structured narrative review was performed. PubMed and Embase were searched from inception to July 2026 using controlled vocabulary and free-text terms for PSC, IBD, cholangiocarcinoma, cholangioscopy, biliary stricture, dysplasia, and surveillance. Clinical practice guidelines, randomised trials, meta-analyses, and large prospective cohorts were prioritised. Four practice-shaping themes emerged. First, the benefit of routine biliary imaging for cholangiocarcinoma surveillance remains uncertain, and its present value lies more in risk stratification and transplant triage than in curative early detection. Second, tissue acquisition during endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) remains the weakest link in the pathway: a positive cholangioscopic biopsy is informative, but a negative result cannot exclude malignancy. Third, for a symptomatic biliary stricture, balloon dilatation rather than short-term stenting should be the initial endoscopic treatment. Fourth, colorectal surveillance is the intervention with the clearest benefit-to-risk ratio in PSC-IBD, yet it is the one most often delivered incompletely in routine practice. In PSC-IBD, the endoscopist should invest maximal effort in the colon, apply ERCP selectively and therapeutically rather than diagnostically, and recognise that biliary surveillance is currently a holding strategy pending better biomarkers. A pragmatic pathway suited to centres without on-site liver transplantation is proposed.
items.summary_cn: 该综述从内镜操作者视角指出，在PSC-IBD患者中结肠镜监测的获益-风险比最明确却最常执行不完整，而ERCP下组织取材是路径中最薄弱环节（胆道镜活检阳性有信息价值但阴性不能排除恶性）；对症状性胆道狭窄应首选球囊扩张而非短期支架置入，常规胆道影像监测的价值更多在于风险分层和移植分诊而非早期治愈性检出。

items.title_cn: GLP-1或GIP受体激动剂治疗慢性胰腺炎的真实世界胃肠道、胰胆、心肾、代谢和营养结局
items.title_en: Real-world Gastrointestinal, Pancreaticobiliary, Cardiorenal, Metabolic and Nutritional Outcomes of GLP-1 or GIP Receptors Agonists -based Therapy in Chronic Pancreatitis.
items.abstract_cn:
背景与目的
胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂及双重葡萄糖依赖性促胰岛素多肽（GIP）/GLP-1受体激动剂越来越多地用于代谢性疾病，但其在慢性胰腺炎（CP）患者中的安全性特征仍不确定。我们比较了暴露于度拉糖肽、司美格鲁肽或替尔泊肽的CP患者与倾向性匹配的未暴露对照组在若干胃肠道、心血管、肾脏及代谢结局方面的差异。

方法
我们使用TriNetX联邦真实世界数据平台开展了一项回顾性、倾向评分匹配的队列研究。伴有CP的成人按记录暴露于度拉糖肽、司美格鲁肽或替尔泊肽 versus 无上述药物暴露记录进行分类。进行了风险分析和Kaplan-Meier时间-事件分析。

结果
匹配后，中位随访时间分别为588（IQR 831）天 versus 879（IQR 807）天。恶心/呕吐发生于656/4,938例（风险0.133） versus 1,099/5,585例（风险0.197），风险比（RR）为0.675（95%CI：0.618-0.738），风险比（HR）为0.710（95%CI：0.645-0.783）。肠梗阻/肠麻痹发生于241/9,103例（风险0.026） versus 466/8,949例（风险0.052），RR=0.508（95%CI：0.436-0.592），HR=0.556（95%CI：0.476-0.649）。上消化道出血发生于355/8,536例（风险0.042） versus 608/8,657例（风险0.070），RR=0.592（95%CI：0.521-0.673），HR=0.659（95%CI：0.578-0.751）。胆道/操作性结局较低，包括胆囊切除术（风险0.023 vs 0.049；HR=0.486，95%CI：0.412-0.572）和ERCP（风险0.026 vs 0.064；HR=0.420，95%CI：0.362-0.488）。复发性急性胰腺炎发生于329/5,639例暴露患者（风险0.058） versus 579/5,499例对照（风险0.105），HR=0.584（95%CI：0.510-0.669）。其他关联包括较低的胰岛素起始治疗（风险0.178 vs 0.269；HR=0.731，95%CI：0.658-0.812）、心力衰竭（风险0.061 vs 0.101；HR=0.687，95%CI：0.613-0.770）、心肌梗死（风险0.039 vs 0.054；HR=0.818，95%CI：0.712-0.939）和急性肾损伤（风险0.086 vs 0.150；HR=0.643，95%CI：0.580-0.712）、营养不良（风险0.049 vs 0.107；HR=0.491，95%CI：0.438-0.550）。

结论
暴露于度拉糖肽、司美格鲁肽或替尔泊肽与若干胃肠道、心血管、肾脏及代谢结局领域中较低的记录风险相关。这些发现应谨慎解读，尚需进一步的前瞻性研究予以证实。
items.abstract_en:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS
Glucagon-like peptide-1(GLP-1) receptor agonists and dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP)/GLP-1 receptor agonists are increasingly used for metabolic disease, but their safety profile in patients with chronic pancreatitis (CP) remains uncertain. We compared several gastrointestinal, cardio, renal and metabolic outcomes in patients with CP exposed to dulaglutide, semaglutide, or tirzepatide versus propensity-matched unexposed controls.


METHODS
We conducted a retrospective, propensity score-matched cohort study using the TriNetX federated real-world data platform. Adults with CP were classified by recorded exposure to dulaglutide, semaglutide, or tirzepatide versus no recorded exposure to those drugs. Risk analyses and Kaplan-Meier time-to-event analyses were done.


RESULTS
After matching, median follow-up was 588 (IQR 831) versus 879 (IQR 807), respectively. Nausea/vomiting occurred in 656/4,938 (risk 0.133) versus 1,099/5,585 (risk 0.197), with risk ratio (RR) 0.675 (95%CI: 0.618-0.738) and hazard ratio (HR) 0.710 (95%CI: 0.645-0.783). Bowel obstruction/ileus occurred in 241/9,103 (risk 0.026) versus 466/8,949 (risk 0.052), with RR=0.508 (95%CI: 0.436-0.592) and HR=0.556 (95%CI: 0.476-0.649). Upper gastrointestinal bleeding occurred in 355/8,536 (risk 0.042) versus 608/8,657 (risk 0.070), with RR=0.592 (95%CI: 0.521-0.673) and HR=0.659 (95%CI: 0.578-0.751). Biliary/procedural outcomes were lower, including cholecystectomy (risk 0.023 vs 0.049; HR=0.486, 95%CI: 0.412-0.572) and ERCP (risk 0.026 vs 0.064; HR=0.420, 95%CI: 0.362-0.488). Recurrent acute pancreatitis occurred in 329/5,639 exposed patients (risk 0.058) versus 579/5,499 controls (risk 0.105), with HR=0.584 (95%CI: 0.510-0.669). Additional associations included lower insulin initiation (risk 0.178 vs 0.269; HR=0.731, 95%CI: 0.658-0.812), heart failure (risk 0.061 vs 0.101; HR=0.687, 95%CI: 0.613-0.770), myocardial infarction (risk 0.039 vs 0.054; HR=0.818, 95%CI: 0.712-0.939 and acute kidney injury (risk 0.086 vs 0.150; HR=0.643, 95%CI: 0.580-0.712), malnutrition (risk 0.049 vs 0.107; HR=0.491, 95%CI: 0.438-0.550).


CONCLUSIONS
Exposure to dulaglutide, semaglutide, or tirzepatide was associated with lower recorded risks across several gastrointestinal, cardio, renal and metabolic outcome domains. These findings should be interpreted with caution, and further prospective studies are required to confirm the same.

items.summary_cn: 在慢性胰腺炎患者中，使用度拉糖肽、司美格鲁肽或替尔泊肽与倾向评分匹配的未暴露对照相比，与多项胃肠道、胆道/操作、心血管、肾脏及代谢结局的较低记录风险相关，包括上消化道出血、ERCP、复发性急性胰腺炎、心力衰竭、心肌梗死、急性肾损伤及营养不良等。该研究为回顾性真实世界队列研究，结果需谨慎解读并需前瞻性研究证实。

items.title_cn: 需要手术治疗的胰腺疾病的临床谱、外科管理及结局：一项为期五年的回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Clinical Spectrum, Surgical Management, and Outcomes of Pancreatic Disorders Requiring Surgery: A Five-Year Retrospective Cohort Study
items.abstract_cn: 背景：需要手术治疗的胰腺疾病在临床表现、手术管理和相关结局方面各不相同。我们描述了一个为期五年、单中心队列中的诊断谱系、手术管理、围手术期结局和疾病特异性随访情况。方法：我们开展了一项回顾性队列研究，纳入2021年1月至2025年12月在印度卡纳塔克邦一家三级医疗中心因胰腺疾病接受手术的患者。主要结局是主要术后并发症，定义为30天内发生Clavien-Dindo III-V级并发症。死亡率评估时间为30天内或本次住院期间。利用现有随访资料按疾病组总结较长期结局。结果：在筛查的138份记录中，纳入112例患者：62例慢性胰腺炎，21例急性坏死性胰腺炎，18例胰腺肿瘤，11例先天性异常。20/112例患者（17.9%）发生主要并发症，其中13/21例（61.9%）为急性坏死性胰腺炎患者。3例患者在30天内或本次住院期间死亡（3/112，2.7%）；均在急性坏死性胰腺炎组（3/21，14.3%）。在慢性胰腺炎组中，52/62例患者（83.9%）报告了有记录的持久疼痛缓解，中位随访时间为32个月。所有18例肿瘤患者均达到显微镜下切缘阴性（R0）；在中位随访36个月期间未记录到复发。所有11例环状胰腺患者的梗阻症状均得到缓解。结论：在本队列中，主要并发症和所有报告的死亡均发生在急性坏死性胰腺炎组。在有记录随访的患者中，疾病特异性结局良好，包括慢性胰腺炎手术后的疼痛缓解、肿瘤切除后的切缘阴性以及环状胰腺手术后的梗阻缓解。这些发现为描述性结果，应结合单中心设计、亚组样本量和现有随访情况加以解读。
items.abstract_en: Background: Pancreatic disorders requiring surgery differ in their presentation, operative management, and relevant outcomes. We describe the diagnostic spectrum, surgical management, perioperative outcomes, and disease-specific follow-up in a five-year, single-centre cohort. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of patients who underwent surgery for a pancreatic disorder at a tertiary-care centre in Karnataka, India, from January 2021 through December 2025. The primary outcome was major postoperative morbidity, defined as a Clavien-Dindo grade III-V complication within 30 days. Mortality was assessed within 30 days or during the index admission. Longer-term outcomes were summarized by disease group using available follow-up. Results: Of 138 records screened, 112 patients were included: 62 with chronic pancreatitis, 21 with acute necrotizing pancreatitis, 18 with pancreatic neoplasms, and 11 with congenital anomalies. Major morbidity occurred in 20/112 patients (17.9%), including 13/21 (61.9%) with acute necrotizing pancreatitis. Three patients died within 30 days or during the index admission (3/112, 2.7%); all were in the acute necrotizing pancreatitis group (3/21, 14.3%). In the chronic pancreatitis group, documented durable pain relief was reported in 52/62 patients (83.9%), with a median follow-up of 32 months. All 18 patients with neoplasms had microscopically negative resection margins (R0); no recurrence was documented during a median follow-up of 36 months. Obstructive symptoms resolved in all 11 patients with annular pancreas. Conclusion: In this cohort, major morbidity and all reported deaths occurred in the acute necrotizing pancreatitis group. Disease-specific outcomes were favourable among patients with documented follow-up, including pain relief after chronic pancreatitis surgery, negative margins after neoplasm resection, and resolution of obstruction after annular pancreas surgery. These findings are descriptive and should be interpreted in light of the single-centre design, subgroup sizes, and available follow-up.
items.summary_cn: 该回顾性队列研究纳入112例因胰腺疾病接受手术的患者，发现主要术后并发症（Clavien-Dindo III-V级）发生率为17.9%，且集中于急性坏死性胰腺炎组（61.9%）；全部3例死亡（2.7%）均发生于急性坏死性胰腺炎组（14.3%）。慢性胰腺炎术后83.9%患者获得持久疼痛缓解，胰腺肿瘤患者均达R0切除且随访期内无复发。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
